newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: RUGBY UNION-CLARKE OUT OF WELSH GAME, NESDALE IN.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CLARKE OUT OF WELSH GAME, NESDALE IN.

text.p: New Zealand-born hooker Ross Nesdale will win his first cap for Ireland on Saturday after original choice Allen Clarke withdrew with a hand injury on Monday from the side to face Wales in the Five Nations championship in Cardiff.
Clarke, selected in place of the injured Keith Wood, broke a bone in his left hand playing for his club Northampton against Coventry in a Pilkington Cup tie in England.
Nesdale, 27, who plays for Newcastle and came on as a replacement for Ireland A against France A earlier this month, qualifies for Ireland through his paternal grandfather.
